title: Plate Tectonics
summary: Plate tectonics explains earthquakes, volcanoes and mountain building.

key_concepts.explanation: A boundary where new crust forms.

outline.heading: Plate boundaries
points: Plates diverge, converge or slide past each other.

outline.heading: Evidence
points: Matching fossils appear on separated continents.
Seafloor age increases away from ridges.

questions: Why is the Pacific rim called the ring of fire?
